method.fresh: empty Catalog; filesystem cache not flushed
method.queries: all five paged showcase routes after warm refresh
method.inputDecode: targeted Enhanced Input step from fresh runs
method.baselineJavaScript: reconstructed seven baseline source files from HEAD, built original assets adapter and Workbench, restored current sources before measuring; then rebuilt current artifacts; additive v1.4 protocol schemas and client-only extension exports were shared by both builds
method.workbench: Electron launch to visible project package count; disposable user data; fresh plus restart using that cache; all samples retained
method.memory: sampled process working sets, not allocator accounting
